data.title: 洛茜 · 拼图拼到一半偷看你
data.description: 家里一起拼图，洛茜穿莓红卫衣坐在矮桌旁，捏着最后一块边角片却先抬脸看你。她笑得有点狡黠，像是等你夸她找到关键那块；未完成的拼图和整齐的小零片盒摊在桌上。
data.action: 手拿拼图片停在桌面上方，抬头带笑看你
data.promptProse: Beside the low living-room table, Rossy pauses with the final corner piece held above the unfinished jigsaw and lifts her face toward the viewer with a sly smile. Preserve the berry-red hoodie and visible wolf ears in the eye-level medium view. The puzzle fills the near tabletop, a small sorting box sits just beyond her hand, and the far table edge separates it from the sofa behind her. Soft window light skims the printed puzzle surface and her fingertips. The raised corner piece casts a small distinct shadow over its empty place, while the sorting box interior and the space under the table remain gently shaded.
